selection_rationale: K-Means with k-means++ initialization is recommended as the primary production model. In log-standardized RFM space, K-Means yields distinct, balanced customer segments with superior Silhouette and Calinski-Harabasz scores. DBSCAN (default eps=0.45, min_samples=5) produced multiple clusters with low noise on the synthetic demo in this run, but remains secondary and data-dependent; see dbscan_sensitivity_analysis.json. Metrics above are from the synthetic demo pipeline, not full UCI.
